Addiction Treatment + Detox
October 4, 2022

For many seeking recovery from drug and alcohol abuse, location may be a vital aspect in finding the right treatment center for you. If you are searching for addiction treatment in Palo Alto, Marina Harbor Detox may be the answer.

Palo Alto, CA, sits in the northwestern corner of Santa Clara County. Famous for being the “birthplace of Silicon Valley,” Palo Alto is home to approximately 70,000 full-time residents and about 100,000 jobs. Recent census data indicates Palo Alto is one of the most expensive cities in the United States to reside in, and its residents are among the most highly educated in the nation. Unfortunately, Palo Alto also has a youth suicide rate of approximately four times the national average.

Palo Alto is home to several high-tech companies’ headquarters, including HP, Skype, and Lockheed Martin. Between 2000 and 2010, the average population grew nearly 10% before increasing an additional 6.5% in the next decade. Just over 5.5% of the population lives below the poverty line, and only 33,000 of the area’s 70,000 residents have stable employment.
Substance Abuse in Palo Alto

Palo Alto and Santa Clara County struggle to manage many of the same drug and alcohol abuse challenges faced by cities and states across the nation. In recent years, the opioid drug fentanyl has gained attention due to the growing rise in deaths attributed to fentanyl use and abuse. However, in Santa Clara County, fentanyl is not the primary source of a drug overdose.

Methamphetamine-related deaths in the county account for more than 50% of all overdose-related deaths, far exceeding those related to opioid abuse and addiction. Recent statistics indicate between January 2018 and July 2022, 1,400 people in Santa Clara county died from a drug overdose. Nearly 44% (582) of those were caused by methamphetamine use. An additional 204 were caused by a combination of methamphetamine and opioid use. In stark contrast, coroners’ reports from the same time indicate opioids alone were responsible for 23.3% of drug-related fatalities while other substances contributed to 18%.

According to estimates from the 2021 U.S Census and coroners reports from the same period, drug-related deaths among whites occurred at nearly two times their percentage compared to the country’s population.

Data also shows that drug overdose, specifically involving methamphetamine, kills more men (77.3%) in Palo Alto and surrounding Santa Clara County than women (22.7%). The largest group dying from substance overdose were middle-aged individuals. Over 30% of those who died from overdose were between 51 and 60 years old.
What Types of Rehab Are Available in Palo Alto?

Addiction is a dangerous and complex disease. Regardless of their substance of choice, everyone will experience different challenges when using and trying to achieve sobriety. Most addictions are difficult to overcome without support and guidance, and some, namely alcohol, opioids, and benzodiazepines, can be dangerous to quit cold turkey. Seeking help at a Palo Alto rehab center can ensure you have the medical and mental health monitoring you need to safely and successfully navigate the early stages of drug and alcohol withdrawal.

The duration, onset, and severity of withdrawal symptoms will vary based on several factors unique to you and your relationship with substances. For example, the severity of your addiction, the type of substance used, how long you have been using, how often you use, and your history with addiction treatment all contribute to your detox journey. Additionally, other co-occurring medical or mental health conditions must be addressed during detox as they can hinder your treatment progress.

Medically-supervised drug and alcohol detoxification

The first stage of many addiction recovery plans involves detox or detoxification. Detox is necessary to allow your body the time it needs to cleanse itself of any remaining toxins still present since you last drank or used. However, detox is also when the most severe and potentially most dangerous withdrawal symptoms can occur. In a medical detox center in San Francisco, professional medical and mental health providers are available to ensure your safety as you start your recovery.

Depending on your unique treatment needs as you begin detox, this may involve monitoring your vital signs, administering medications, or intervening in the case of a medical or mental health emergency. Additionally, providers will offer nutritional support and other essential guidance allowing you to focus on your recovery rather than withdrawal symptoms.
Inpatient drug and alcohol addiction treatment

There are several levels of care at addiction treatment centers in California. Inpatient or residential treatment is the most intensive yet often the most effective treatment environment. Once you have completed detox, it is crucial to transition to a therapy program to help you better understand your addiction and develop the coping tools and strategies you will need to avoid relapse in the future. Although detox is a vital first step, it is not a substitute for comprehensive, evidence-based therapy. A residential treatment program requires you to live “on-site” at our Palo Alto rehab center throughout the duration of your recovery program.
